visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young boys wearing matching black T-shirts with colorful graphics run across a wide, gray-tiled urban plaza. In the background, a large modern building with a curved white facade and outdoor stairs is visible under bright, slightly overcast daylight. (2) The scene cuts to a long, straight pedestrian path lined with tall, green-leafed trees. One boy is now wearing a white hoodie with a brown bear ear design on the back. They run away from the camera as sunlight creates long shadows on the ground. (3) The boys stop in front of a red, Pokémon-themed mailbox located on an urban sidewalk near a glass storefront. One boy points at a Piplup statue on top of the mailbox, and they both perform a synchronized dance with joyful expressions. (4) A young boy in a black shirt walks along a waterfront boardwalk with the historic red brick buildings of Yokohama in the distance. The sky is bright blue, and other pedestrians are walking in the background near a river or harbor. (5) The two boys squat down around a circular metal ground feature that is emitting a thick cloud of white smoke or mist, looking at it with focused curiosity. (6) A close-up shot shows a round, colorful manhole cover on a stone-paved street, featuring a design of Pikachu and Victini with a city background. (7) The boys are seen running past various urban landmarks, including a large Ferris wheel and a gondola system, under clear sunny skies. (8) The two children sit cross-legged on the ground near a harbor with sailboats and a large bridge visible in the background, smiling and making peace signs at the camera. (9) The video concludes with the boys standing next to two Pokémon-themed mailboxes, one topped with Pikachu and the other with Eevee, in front of a modern city building entrance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an upbeat acoustic guitar and percussion instrumental track. A male adult narrator speaks in a clear, friendly, and enthusiastic tone, introducing two children and their activity. (2) As the narration describes the challenge of a long-distance run and the 'Pokémon mission,' the music maintains a steady, happy rhythm. No significant external sound effects are heard, suggesting a studio-recorded voiceover. (3) The narrator lists various locations and describes the manhole covers with a consistent, informative pace. The BGM serves as a bright melodic foundation under the speech. (4) In the final segment, the narrator's tone becomes more playful as he explains a linguistic misunderstanding by the children. The audio maintains high clarity and fades out naturally as the video ends.
